preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer q (2 ≤ q ≤ 10^5) representing the number of tasks.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0] == '1' and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: For type 1 tasks, the input line must contain exactly two integers: t_i = 1 and u_i (1 ≤ u_i ≤ 10^5).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 4 and line.split()[0] == '2' and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**5 and 1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**5 and 1 <= int(line.split()[3]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2')
preconditions.description: For type 2 tasks, the input line must contain exactly four integers: t_i = 2, x_i, k_i, and s_i (1 ≤ x_i, k_i, s_i ≤ 10^5).
The first task must be of type 1.
There must be at least one task of type 2.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['-1'] or (1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**5 and int(line.strip()) in [int(u) for u in a]) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each type 2 task, the output line must be either -1 or a valid number v existing in the array a at the time of the query.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda: (lambda x_i, k_i, s_i: any((k_i == 0 or k_i != 0 and k_i % math.gcd(int(x_i), v) == 0) and (int(x_i) + v <= int(s_i)) for v in a))(line.split()[1], line.split()[2], line.split()[3]) or line.strip() == '-1') for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2')
postconditions.description: For each type 2 task, if there exists a v in a such that k_i divides GCD(x_i, v) and x_i + v ≤ s_i, the output must be such a v that maximizes x_i XOR v; otherwise, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda: (lambda x_i, k_i, s_i: max((x_i ^ v for v in a if (k_i == 0 or k_i != 0 and k_i % math.gcd(int(x_i), v) == 0) and (int(x_i) + v <= int(s_i))), default=-1) == (x_i ^ int(line.strip())) if line.strip() != '-1' else True) for line, x_i, k_i, s_i in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2'], [line.split()[2] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2'], [line.split()[3] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2']))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 task, if the output is not -1, it must be the v in a that maximizes x_i XOR v among all valid v.
